besluite.rede: The plural 'daardie howe' cannot point at the singular 'n Landdroshof', so it already points unambiguously to 'die hoër howe'; the proposal names the same courts but repeats 'hoër howe' two sentences apart, so it is a lateral move on a fact-checked sentence.

'daardie grense' refers naturally to the limits that 'beperk' sets out in the line before (and the heading 'Mag met grense' names them), while 'die grense' loosens that link without reading better, so this is a lateral move.
